name: Orbit Camera Basis Computation
aliases: Camera Pan via View Space Vectors
definition: Computes an orthonormal camera basis (eye, forward, right, up) for an orbit camera looking at a target from a distance, oriented by yaw and pitch angles.
summary: Orbit Camera Basis Computation calculates an orthonormal camera basis using spherical coordinates, differing from standard look-at methods by deriving eye position from parametric angles rather than accepting a pre-computed position.
